subject: CloudForge marketplace contact — intro and demo scheduling
messages:
From: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@cloudforge.ai>
To: sales@redwood.com
Cc: Jessica Li <jessica@cloudforge.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Inquiry via Marketplace — quick intro + demo?

Hi Redwood team,

We came across your listing on the Cloud Marketplace and I wanted to reach out — we're evaluating inference platforms to replace an internal service for retrieval-augmented search and chat, and the performance/cost claims on your listing looked promising.

Would love a short intro call and a demo to understand:
- typical latency at 1–5k qps for medium-length prompts
- multi-tenant vs dedicated capacity options
- integration paths (API vs marketplace connector)
- pricing ranges for production deployments

We're a mid-stage infra company (CloudForge). I'm Paul Reynolds, Head of ML. If possible we'd like a 30-minute slot next week. We're based in PDT.

Thanks — feel free to suggest an available time or send a calendar link.

Paul
Paul Reynolds
Head of ML, CloudForge
paul.reynolds@cloudforge.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: none
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@cloudforge.ai>, Jessica Li <jessica@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:25:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry via Marketplace — quick intro + demo?

Hi Paul — welcome and thanks for reaching out. I'm Stephanie, I'm on the SDR team and I handle inbound marketplace leads. Happy to set up a 30-minute intro + demo.

Proposed 30-min slots (PDT):
- Mon 3/2 10:00–10:30
- Tue 3/3 14:00–14:30
- Wed 3/4 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, send over a couple times that do. Would you like a short agenda? I typically include a solutions engineer to cover architecture and integration — looping in Marcus to join the call.

Quick agenda options (pick one):
1) Product tour + integration options (30m)
2) Architecture deep-dive + capacity planning (30m)

Also, do you have any compliance/regulatory requirements (data residency, SOC 2, etc.) we should prep for?

I can send a Calendly link or we can confirm a slot here.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Inbound SDR | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the quick reply.

Tue 3/3 14:00–14:30 PDT works for us. Please include Marcus for the capacity/architecture bits.

Agenda: Architecture deep-dive + capacity planning (option 2). Also useful if you can touch on:
- multi-region deployment options (we're evaluating US + EU)
- data handling (are logs or inputs retained by default?)
- pricing: ballpark monthly estimate for 200k tokens/day with burst capacity

Attendees from our side: myself (Paul), Jessica Li (ops), and I may add Leah Kim (platform eng) if she can join.

Thanks — send the invite and any prep materials.

Paul

Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:36:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry via Marketplace — quick intro + demo?

Hi Paul — Marcus here (Solutions Engineering). Thanks for confirming Tue 3/3 14:00 PDT — I've tentatively held that slot on my calendar.

I've attached a short demo deck that covers our serving tiers, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and a few capacity sizing examples: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (application/pdf).

Proposed 30-min agenda (tight):
- 0–5m: intros + key goals
- 5–18m: demo of hosted + dedicated deployment paths (focus on latency at scale)
- 18–26m: capacity planning + cost estimates for your 200k tokens/day scenario
- 26–30m: next steps (trial, Dedicated sizing, SOC 2 evidence)

Prep asks: can you share a rough QPS distribution (avg and p95) and whether you need EU data residency? That'll help me bring preliminary sizing.

Calendly link to confirm invite: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min?event=cloudforge-intro-2026-02-27
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example/contacts/lead/CF-4829
Drive deck for reference: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-redwood-demo-deck

See you Tue.
–Marcus
Marcus Lin

Perfect — thanks everyone. I've added Leah Kim (platform eng) to the thread and she'll try to join Tue 3/3 14:00 PDT.

Per Marcus's ask: our typical traffic is bursty; avg QPS ~150, p95 ~900 during peak tests. We do need EU residency for some customer data, but for the initial evaluation US-first is fine. I'll upload a short telemetry snapshot to the Drive link Marcus shared before the call.

Look forward to the demo. Please send the calendar invite when convenient.

Paul
